explanation: Delivery treats the Visium atlas as built, not fetched: deployInputs.mts splits BUILT_ATLASES from FETCHED_ATLAS_DIRS, fetch:expression (and its CI identity) covers only the fetched three, prepare:deploy runs the Visium builder when the atlas is missing, and CI builds it before tests. delivery.md records the measured build: 17.4 MB in 2,050 Visium files and 11,079 deployable dist files in all, largest 17.5 MB, within the 20,000-file and 25 MiB Workers limits.
